arxiv:2610.09823.title: UltraText Bench: A Comprehensive Bilingual Benchmark for Evaluating Visual Text Rendering in Image Generation

arxiv:2610.10409.title: RobotWorld: Benchmarking Multimodal Agents for Robot Use Across Diverse Tasks and Embodiments

arxiv:2610.17805.title: BRIDGE: Selective Boundary Repair with Dependency Graph Evidence in Multi-Agent Systems

arxiv:2610.18272.title: JevGPT: Thinking Fast and Slow in Autonomous Research
